evidence: The crystallization state of such ESD and ALD films was studied by electron diffraction. Comparative performances vs temperature of such ESD and ALD thin films used as barriers to copper diffusion were investigated, after different treatments from 600 to 800°C, using X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. The crystallization state of such ESD and ALD films was studied by electron diffraction. After annealing at 980°C in O2, a mixture of monoclinic and rhombohedral phases was detected by electron diffraction. The structure of the crystallized films was found to be pure monoclinic.
